monetization25.privacy: Commercial click measurement is aggregate. Affiliate click events and optional support links do not store raw IP addresses, browser fingerprints, or cross-site visitor identifiers. Affiliate signup attribution links only an internal registered user to the preceding referral partner. A076 artifacts are scoped to the authenticated user's own gameplay sessions and coaching tips and exclude credentials, auth tokens, visitor identifiers, owner audit data, and other users' rows. A077 priority actions are scoped to the authenticated user's own open custom-report requests.
monetization25.safety: Commercial resources stay visibly separate from gameplay evidence. HTTPS-only external destinations, unsafe guarantee-claim rejection, explicit sponsored/voluntary-support disclosure, honest external-unverified payment state, user-scoped export access, historical-only export language, and honest priority queue semantics are enforced. A click is never treated as a completed donation or purchase. Manual entitlement provisioning is never represented as provider-verified payment, and priority queue placement never claims guaranteed completion time or gameplay outcome.

returnUser49.rule: Return-user analytics describe authorized recorded history only. Personal bests, efficiency summaries, time patterns, ratings, goals and achievements must not be framed as predictions of random outcomes, causal proof, or profit guarantees.

patterns: pace increased while recorded results weakened
long session with no recorded break
coreLoopIntegration.rule: Analysis and C014 comparisons describe authorized recorded evidence only. Correlation is not causation. Random credit outcomes are never treated as proof coaching worked, and no hidden server state or future random outcome is predicted.

exactTelemetryBoundary.rule: Only the separately owned F.S.A. integration may submit exact telemetry.
